From General-Purpose AI to Industry-Specific Innovation: Why I Built LiteLawyer

Kevan Bartz

Founder · New York, New York

Artificial intelligence has rapidly evolved from an emerging technology into an essential business tool. While much of the conversation has centered on increasingly capable general-purpose AI models, the next stage of innovation is already taking shape: specialized platforms designed to solve the unique challenges of individual industries.

That philosophy guided my most recent venture.

Rather than developing an AI platform from the ground up, I acquired an existing artificial intelligence platform with a strong technical foundation. The platform was already capable and well-designed, but I recognized an opportunity to create significantly greater value by narrowing its focus and tailoring the experience to a specific professional market.

The result was not simply a rebrand. It was the creation of an entirely new platform, identity, and long-term vision.

Building a Vertical AI Platform

Every profession has its own language, workflows, regulatory requirements, and operational challenges. Although general-purpose AI offers remarkable flexibility, it often lacks the contextual understanding necessary to integrate seamlessly into specialized industries.

By concentrating on a single market, artificial intelligence becomes substantially more practical. User experiences become more intuitive, workflows become more efficient, and the technology delivers greater value because it is designed around the way professionals actually work.

This principle became the foundation for LiteLawyer.

Rather than attempting to build a platform that serves every industry equally, LiteLawyer was created specifically for legal professionals. Every design decision, feature, and workflow is intended to complement the practice of law and the day-to-day responsibilities of attorneys and legal staff.

"Rather than asking legal professionals to adapt to generic AI software, LiteLawyer adapts to the legal profession."

Creating an Independent Brand

An important part of this project was maintaining a clear distinction between the original platform and the new product.

The original AI platform continues to exist independently and remains available for its intended audience and broader applications. At the same time, LiteLawyer has been developed as its own standalone brand, complete with a unique identity, user experience, and product roadmap.

This separation allows each platform to evolve according to the needs of its respective audience while preserving the strengths of the underlying technology.

The Development Process

Modern software development has changed dramatically with the emergence of AI-assisted engineering. Throughout the development of LiteLawyer, artificial intelligence accelerated many aspects of the design and development process, allowing ideas to move from concept to implementation with unprecedented speed.

However, technology alone does not create successful products.

Creating a valuable platform requires understanding an industry's specific needs, designing meaningful user experiences, and building software that solves real business problems. AI can accelerate development, but thoughtful product strategy remains the deciding factor.

Why Vertical AI Represents the Future

As artificial intelligence continues to mature, businesses will increasingly seek solutions designed specifically for their industries rather than relying exclusively on general-purpose platforms.

Law firms require different capabilities than healthcare providers. Financial institutions operate under different regulatory frameworks than construction companies. Every profession presents distinct operational requirements that benefit from specialized tools.

The future of artificial intelligence will be shaped not only by larger language models, but by purpose-built platforms that combine advanced AI with deep industry expertise.

Introducing LiteLawyer

LiteLawyer represents this vision.

Developed specifically for the legal profession, the platform is designed to help attorneys and legal professionals streamline routine tasks, improve operational efficiency, and leverage artificial intelligence within workflows that reflect the realities of modern legal practice.

Rather than asking legal professionals to adapt to generic AI software, LiteLawyer adapts to the legal profession.

If you are interested in exploring how specialized artificial intelligence can improve your practice, visit LiteLawyer.com to learn more about the platform and its capabilities.

"The organizations that gain the greatest advantage will be those that adopt solutions designed specifically for the work they do."

Artificial intelligence is transforming every industry. The organizations that gain the greatest advantage will be those that adopt solutions designed specifically for the work they do. LiteLawyer was created with that principle in mind, and it reflects my belief that the future of AI lies not only in more powerful technology, but in more purposeful applications.
